info.name: Core accepted countries Credit Accounts API

params.name: card_token
params.description: Unique identifier of the credit card associated with the account.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of credit account resources to retrieve.

params.name: start_index
params.description: Sort order index of the first resource in the returned array.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
Field on which to sort.
Prefix the field name with a hyphen (`-`) to sort in descending order.
Omit the hyphen to sort in ascending order.

*NOTE:*
You must sort using system field names such as `lastModifiedTime`, and not by the field names appearing in response bodies such as `last_modified_time`.

params.name: light_response
params.description: If `true`, returns a lightweight response without any balances and usages.

params.name: secured_account_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of an existing secured account.
This field is required when policy product subtype is `SECURED`.

params.name: user_token
params.description: Unique identifier of the user by which to filter accounts.

items.docs:

params.name: effective_fee_schedule_only

params.name: account_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the credit account to retrieve.

Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts` to retrieve existing credit account tokens.
